m1.effect_estimator: Hodges-Lehmann paired median difference, FAR minus baseline
m1.test_statistic: arithmetic mean of case-level paired differences (FAR minus baseline)
m1.null_randomization: paired sign flip; zero differences fixed at zero
m1.extreme_rule: absolute permuted statistic >= absolute observed statistic

authority: Numerical parameters copied from the preregistration; changing any value requires a new benchmark version before execution.

missingness.at_or_below_threshold: complete-pair analysis plus worst-case sensitivity analysis

falsification.m1: Hodges-Lehmann estimate >= +0.05 with corresponding Holm-adjusted M1 test significant
falsification.m2: 95% bootstrap upper bound for FAR minus baseline < -0.05
